title: Labeling a reusable daily dosage planner with the statutory label information for each medication
rule_summary: Under 247 CMR 9.07(5), one of the requirements on which a pharmacy may dispense medications in a reusable daily dosage planner at the patient's or patient's agent's request is that the pharmacy labels each reusable daily dosage planner with all information required by M.G.L. c. 94C, s. 21 for each medication.
exam_relevance: Tests that dispensing into a planner does not displace the statutory label: the information M.G.L. c. 94C, s. 21 requires is carried on the planner for each medication in it.
common_confusions: Treating a planner as a patient-owned container that needs no pharmacy label.
Labeling the planner once for the whole set of medications rather than with the required information for each medication.
verification_notes: Read in the official mass.gov PDF of 247 CMR 9.00 (every page stamped 12/6/24, with the note Mass. Register #1536, 12/6/2024), decoded in full with no stream decoding failures, during the authoring session of 2026-09-16 to 2026-09-17.
